pages.text: Singularity-enhanced weapons and armor. $(br)A full set of armor can nullify all damage.
Enhanced Blade of Valor. $(br)Instantly kills enemies attacked 7 times.
Enhanced Angel Ring. $(br)Enhances the original effect and further nullifies falling, choking, and void damage.
Enhanced Crimson plate of Justice. $(br)Reflected damage becomes a special fixed damage, and the damage dealt is doubled. It also nullifies physical damage.
Enhanced Leggings of Saga. $(br)In addition to the original effect, it also nullifies magic, wither, and flying damage.
Enhanced March of the Ruler. $(br)Increases movement speed and nullifies all debuffs. It also negates fire and terrain damage.
